newsitem.title: USA: General Growth offers 4 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: General Growth offers 4 mln shares.

text.p: General Growth Properties Inc said Tuesday it made a public offering of four million shares of its common stock under an existing effective shelf registration.
The proceeds to General Growth from the offering, after underwriter's discount, will be $135,600,000 before giving effect to the exercise of the over-allotment option, the company said.

A portion of the net proceeds will be used to repay two outstanding secured project loans totaling about $113 million, the company said. The balance of the proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including possible future acquisitions and the development of enclosed mall shopping centers, the company said.
General Growth shares fell 1/4 to 34-1/2 tuesday.
